mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an active monetary easing policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a weakening housing market, which contracts consumer demand and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in RSAFS and HOUST fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: During a manufacturing slowdown regime (indicated by a 3-month decline in industrial production), reduced supply capacity lowers corporate output and profits, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO declines by more than 0.5% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the prior month signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases by at least 100,000 over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate tightening monetary policy coinciding with labor market weakness, reducing corporate investment and consumer demand to drive negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in FEDFUNDS and UNRATE fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: During a recessionary demand regime (indicated by a quarterly decline in real GDP growth), the contraction in aggregate demand lowers corporate revenues, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 declines by more than 0.5% in the quarter.
